scripts.db:init: node -e "import('./db/index.js').then(m => m.default.migrate.latest()).then(() => { console.log('DB initialized'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "import('./db/index.js').then(m => m.default.migrate.latest()).then(() => { console.log('Migrations applied'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:rollback: node -e "import('./db/index.js').then(m => m.default.migrate.rollback()).then(() => { console.log('Rolled back'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
